text: The two new Rust tests compare exact request JSON and a typed response list whose incoming IDs arrive in reverse order. Their assert_eq! calls have no messages, including at the fixed accepted revision. They do not directly test splitting into 20-item blocks, omitted build failures, duplicate/missing IDs, typed item failures or partial callback handling. No tests were run; this is assertion coverage inspection.
title: The initial Graph batch tests assert serialized shape and numeric response ordering
